scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:ensure && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:push: npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:reset: npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push --force-reset && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.evals:schema:check: npx tsx scripts/emit-tool-schema.ts evals/.tools.schema.check.json && diff -u evals/tools.schema.json evals/.tools.schema.check.json && rm -f evals/.tools.schema.check.json
scripts.evals: DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.local DOTENV_CONFIG_QUIET=true NODE_OPTIONS=--require=dotenv/config npx webmcp-evals local -t evals/tools.schema.json -e evals/suites/tool-selection.json --backend vercel
scripts.evals:browser: DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.local DOTENV_CONFIG_QUIET=true NODE_OPTIONS=--require=dotenv/config npx tsx scripts/run-browser-evals.ts
